title: VOOPOO Argus G3 Mini Pod Kit
description:
The
VOOPOO Argus G3 Mini Pod Kit
is an ultra-compact open pod system weighing just 40.85g. Powered by the GENE.AI chipset with iCOSM CODE 2.0 technology, it delivers clean flavour for up to 30 days per coil and 100mL of e-liquid endurance.
Product Type:
Open Pod System (Refillable)
Battery:
1350mAh
Wattage:
Up to 30W (Auto-Matched to Coil)
Charging:
USB Type-C (5V/1A)
E-Liquid Capacity:
3mL
Coil Type:
Integrated (Argus Top Fill Cartridge V2)
Coil Resistance:
0.7Ω (included)
Activation:
Draw-Activated (No Buttons)
Display:
LED Battery Indicator
Airflow:
Fixed
Material:
Aluminum Alloy
Pod Compatibility:
All VOOPOO Argus Pod Family cartridges (Argus Top Fill V2, Argus Top Fill, Argus Pod 0.7Ω/1.2Ω)
Brand:
VOOPOO
⚠ Not compatible with PnP X pods or coils (DRAG X3, S3, S2). This device uses Argus Pod cartridges only.
E-liquid sold separately. Fill with your choice of salt nic or freebase e-liquid.
Available options: Midnight Black, Space Gray.
